note: Triennial election of the county council, 1933: nominations received by T. E. Reid, returning officer, 25 April 1933; contests in Armagh and Crossmore, polled 25 May 1933. Polled 25 May 1933. Printed "Armagh City". James O'Neill (Labour) was also nominated but does not appear in the result. McLaughlin was the retiring member.
